definition.never: prefix_policy='never' never prefixes; trajectory equals a plain run on raw bytes
definition.always: prefix_policy='always' prefixes 19/20 steps with the previous text
definition.on_match: prefix_policy='on_match' prefixes only when the sentence hits a written key
definition.control: each policy's bridged trajectory equals a plain observe run on its own input bytes
definition.policy_effect: never vs always differ on all 19 post-first steps; on_match equals always on hitting sentences
definition.discriminate: on the unknown sentence always prefixes the stale text and on_match does not
definition.unknown: the unknown sentence answers no_pair, stores None, and the next step carries no prefix
definition.invalid_policy: an unknown policy name raises ValueError before any step
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.expression: each of the three policies expresses 20/20 exact paired texts
criteria.match_counts: all 20 describe sentences hit a written key (the on_match gate input)
criteria.controls: each policy's bridged trajectory equals its own plain control 20/20
criteria.policy_effect: never vs always differ 19/19 post-first steps; on_match equals always 20/20
criteria.discriminate: unknown-step prefix is not None under always and None under never/on_match; the unknown step state differs
criteria.unknown: all policies: no_pair, stored None, next prefix None
criteria.parameters: parameter hash and table digest unchanged
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal before and after
criteria.rerun: the R34 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
